verdicts.reason: README opens with a one-sentence statement of the site's job: an installable design system distributed as a shadcn registry, with the site itself running the flagship theme.
verdicts.quote: A design system you can install. Themes and components, distributed as a shadcn registry — the site itself runs the flagship theme it ships.

verdicts.reason: Documentation exists (README, NOTICE, commit bodies) but none states a product/business bet nor ties design decisions to one. The README describes what the registry contains and how it is built; 'dogfooding' is mentioned as a mechanism, never framed as a bet or hypothesis. No brief, PRD, plan, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md in the worktree.
verdicts.quote: `catalog/` is the single author-time surface. `registry.json` is generated from it ... the gallery, install commands and site pages all derive from the same catalog

verdicts.reason: No document records stack/time/team/design-system constraints before the build. The only doc is README.md, which describes the stack (Next, shadcn registry, Geist) after the fact as architecture, not as recorded constraints; the bootstrap commit ('bootstrap Studio DS from registry-template') has no constraint rationale. No brief/plan/PRD found.
verdicts.quote: `catalog/` is the single author-time surface. `registry.json` is generated from it (`scripts/build-registry.ts`), `shadcn build` compiles `public/r/*.json`

verdicts.reason: Decision rationale is recorded in commit bodies (e.g. 54fcaf0: 'studio-ds.vercel.app is taken by an unrelated project; the canonical public domain becomes studio-ds-ui.vercel.app'; 1bc295c: 'build script wipes public/r before shadcn build (no stale artifacts)'; f6d1471: 'status-badge embeds the status token vars (self-sufficient install)') and in source comments explaining measured token choices. No ADRs or docs/solutions folder, but the 'why' is consistently captured.
verdicts.quote: as text on light they measured below APCA 60 / WCAG 3:1 (building 2.44:1, done 2.37:1), so ink keeps C and H and lowers L to the measured minimum.
